---
title: "03_season_all_species_analysis"
output: html_document
---

Purpose: process the all-species seasonal models (`02_season_all_species.qmd`, one shrinkage
difference-smooth model per species) into per-species stage curves, subadult - adult contrast
curves and summaries, an "is seasonal change assessable?" flag, a first-pass typology, and
consistency checks against the unified model (m11g) and the six-species stage-curve models
(`03_season_analysis.Rmd`). Export basic results.

The aim is comparable per-species profiles, not a cross-species claim: species are shown in
phylogenetic order so related species (e.g. *R. muscosa* / *R. sierrae*, the three *Anaxyrus*)
can be read side by side.

Scales used throughout (as in `03_season_analysis.Rmd`):

- **prevalence part**: the hurdle (hu) is the probability of a zero (Bd not detected). Curves are
  shown as prevalence = 1 - hu; contrasts are on the **logit prevalence** scale (= -logit(hu)),
  so a positive contrast means subadults are *more often infected*.
- **load part**: mu = mean log Bd load density among positive swabs. Contrasts are differences in
  mu (log scale): positive = subadults carry *higher loads when infected*.
- All curves exclude random effects (`re_formula = NA`): a typical population and year.
- **Season axis**: days (or weeks) since each species' seasonal origin (the middle of its longest
  sampling gap, from `01_season_screen.Rmd`). For plots this is mapped back to calendar months,
  starting at the origin, so seasons that cross the new year (Panama) stay continuous.

Run order: `01_season_screen.Rmd` (species table), cluster fits copied into
`size_bd_season/models_all/`, `02_season_all_species.qmd` (full model checks), then this script.
For the six-species comparison, run `03_season_analysis.Rmd` first (optional).

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| output: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show setup code"

# setup
librarian::shelf(tidyverse, here, brms, posterior, patchwork, arrow)

models_dir = here("size_bd_season", "models_all")
figures_dir = here("size_bd_season", "figures")
intermediates_dir = here("size_bd_season", "intermediates")
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(intermediates_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# conv_check, sds_summary, half_t_quantile
source(here("size_bd_season", "season_check_functions.R"))
# f_draw_agg: median / 50% / 95% intervals, net effect, pd and support labels, so contrasts are
# reported in the same language as the unified analysis
source(here("size_bd_unified", "contrast_functions.R"))

```

# Species table and fits
```{r}
# species, seasonal origin (origin_doy) and coverage classes from the screen
season_species_all = read_csv(here("size_bd_season", "intermediates", "01_season_species_all.csv"),
                              show_col_types = FALSE)

model_files = file.path(models_dir, paste0("size_bd_season_all_model_zln_d1_",
                                           season_species_all$taxon_capture, ".rds"))
names(model_files) = season_species_all$taxon_capture

missing_fits = names(model_files)[!file.exists(model_files)]
if (length(missing_fits) > 0) message("no fit yet: ", paste(missing_fits, collapse = ", "))
model_files = model_files[file.exists(model_files)]

# phylogenetic order for plots and tables: tips of the pruned tree from the unified analysis, in
# plotting order after ladderizing (so sister species are adjacent). species not in the tree go
# last, alphabetically.
phylo_tree = ape::ladderize(ape::read.tree(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "phylo_tree.nwk")))
is_tip = phylo_tree$edge[, 2] <= ape::Ntip(phylo_tree)
tip_order = phylo_tree$tip.label[phylo_tree$edge[is_tip, 2]]
species_order = c(intersect(tip_order, names(model_files)),
                  sort(setdiff(names(model_files), tip_order)))

species_label = function(taxon) str_to_sentence(gsub("_", " ", taxon))
species_levels = species_label(species_order)

```

# Process each fit
```{r}
# the fits are large (r. sierrae especially), so each is read, processed and dropped in turn:
# only summaries and a few numbers per draw are kept. the result is cached in intermediates/;
# set refresh = TRUE after replacing any fit.
refresh = FALSE
results_file = file.path(intermediates_dir, "03_all_processed.rds")

# a week counts as sampled for a stage with >= min_n_co swabs (prevalence) or >= min_pos_co
# positive swabs (load), as in the screen. the contrast is only summarized over weeks where BOTH
# stages are sampled ("co-sampled"); elsewhere it is one stage's curve extrapolated.
min_n_co = 5
min_pos_co = 3

# thinning: 2000 of the 8000 draws and a 2-day grid are plenty for summaries and keep memory low
ndraws_use = 2000
grid_step_days = 2

# column-wise median and 50% / 95% intervals of a draws x grid matrix
summ_cols = function(m) {
  q = apply(m, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.975))
  tibble(median = q[3, ], lower_95 = q[1, ], lower_50 = q[2, ],
         upper_50 = q[4, ], upper_95 = q[5, ])
}

process_season_fit = function(fit, spp) {
  # ---- sampled and co-sampled weeks (weeks since origin) ----
  d = fit$data %>%
    mutate(day = season_m * 30.44,
           week = floor(day / 7))

  stage_weeks = d %>%
    group_by(life_stage_simple, week) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), n_pos = sum(bd_load_co100_density > 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(sampled_prevalence = n >= min_n_co,
           sampled_load = n_pos >= min_pos_co)

  co_weeks = stage_weeks %>%
    group_by(week) %>%
    summarise(co_prevalence = sum(sampled_prevalence) == 2,
              co_load = sum(sampled_load) == 2,
              .groups = "drop")

  # ---- linear predictor draws on a grid over the sampled range ----
  days = seq(floor(min(d$day)), ceiling(max(d$day)), by = grid_step_days)
  grid = expand_grid(life_stage_simple = factor(c("adult", "subadult"), levels = c("adult", "subadult")),
                     day = days) %>%
    mutate(season_m = day / 30.44,
           # the difference smooth needs the ordered stage factor in newdata too
           stage_o = ordered(life_stage_simple, levels = c("adult", "subadult")))
  grid_week = floor(days / 7)

  # the same draws for every quantity, so per-draw differences are valid
  set.seed(128)
  draw_ids = sort(sample.int(ndraws(fit), min(ndraws_use, ndraws(fit))))

  hu = posterior_linpred(fit, newdata = grid, dpar = "hu", re_formula = NA, draw_ids = draw_ids)
  mu = posterior_linpred(fit, newdata = grid, dpar = "mu", re_formula = NA, draw_ids = draw_ids)

  ad = grid$life_stage_simple == "adult"
  sa = grid$life_stage_simple == "subadult"
  lp = list(prevalence = list(adult = -hu[, ad], subadult = -hu[, sa]),   # logit prevalence
            load = list(adult = mu[, ad], subadult = mu[, sa]))

  # constant stage offsets: the subadult coefficient is the stage difference where the
  # (centered) difference smooth is 0, i.e. THE difference when that smooth shrinks away. used
  # as the summary for parts with no co-sampled weeks.
  b = as_draws_matrix(fit, variable = c("b_life_stage_simplesubadult",
                                        "b_hu_life_stage_simplesubadult")) %>%
    subset_draws(draw = draw_ids)
  offset = list(prevalence = -as.vector(b[, "b_hu_life_stage_simplesubadult"]),
                load = as.vector(b[, "b_life_stage_simplesubadult"]))

  # ---- curves ----
  stage_curves = map_dfr(c("prevalence", "load"), function(metric) {
    map_dfr(c("adult", "subadult"), function(stage) {
      # computed before tibble(): inside tibble(), later arguments see earlier columns, so
      # `metric` there would be the whole new column, not this loop's single value
      m = lp[[metric]][[stage]]
      curve = summ_cols(if (metric == "prevalence") plogis(m) else m)
      tibble(metric = metric, life_stage_simple = stage, day = days, week = grid_week, curve)
    })
  }) %>%
    left_join(stage_weeks %>%
                mutate(life_stage_simple = as.character(life_stage_simple)) %>%
                select(life_stage_simple, week, sampled_prevalence, sampled_load),
              by = c("life_stage_simple", "week")) %>%
    mutate(sampled = replace_na(if_else(metric == "prevalence", sampled_prevalence, sampled_load), FALSE)) %>%
    select(-sampled_prevalence, -sampled_load)

  contrast_curves = map_dfr(c("prevalence", "load"), function(metric) {
    contrast = lp[[metric]]$subadult - lp[[metric]]$adult
    tibble(metric = metric, day = days, week = grid_week,
           summ_cols(contrast), p_gt_0 = colMeans(contrast > 0))
  }) %>%
    left_join(co_weeks, by = "week") %>%
    mutate(co_sampled = replace_na(if_else(metric == "prevalence", co_prevalence, co_load), FALSE)) %>%
    select(-co_prevalence, -co_load)

  # ---- per-draw summaries over the co-sampled window ----
  #   window_mean       mean contrast over co-sampled days (each day weighted equally)
  #   early / late      mean contrast over the first / last third of co-sampled days (thirds
  #                     rather than end points: spline edges are the least certain)
  #   late_minus_early  change in the stage gap through the season (> 0: subadults gain)
  #   amplitude         max - min of the contrast curve within the window: how much it moves
  #                     at all (always >= 0, so its pd / support are not meaningful)
  summary_draws = map_dfr(c("prevalence", "load"), function(metric) {
    contrast = lp[[metric]]$subadult - lp[[metric]]$adult
    co_week_set = co_weeks$week[co_weeks[[paste0("co_", metric)]]]
    idx = which(grid_week %in% co_week_set)

    if (length(idx) >= 3) {
      thirds = cut(seq_along(idx), 3, labels = FALSE)
      cw = contrast[, idx, drop = FALSE]
      early = rowMeans(contrast[, idx[thirds == 1], drop = FALSE])
      late = rowMeans(contrast[, idx[thirds == 3], drop = FALSE])
      tibble(metric = metric, .draw = seq_along(draw_ids), window = "co-sampled",
             window_mean = rowMeans(cw), early = early, late = late,
             late_minus_early = late - early,
             amplitude = apply(cw, 1, function(x) max(x) - min(x)))
    } else {
      # too few co-sampled days for a seasonal summary: report the constant offset only
      # (looked up before tibble(), for the same reason as in stage_curves)
      constant = offset[[metric]]
      tibble(metric = metric, .draw = seq_along(draw_ids), window = "none (constant offset)",
             window_mean = constant, early = NA_real_, late = NA_real_,
             late_minus_early = NA_real_, amplitude = NA_real_)
    }
  })

  window_info = map_dfr(c("prevalence", "load"), function(metric) {
    co_week_set = co_weeks$week[co_weeks[[paste0("co_", metric)]]]
    tibble(metric = metric,
           n_co_weeks = length(co_week_set),
           first_co_day = if (length(co_week_set) > 0) min(co_week_set) * 7 else NA_real_,
           last_co_day = if (length(co_week_set) > 0) max(co_week_set) * 7 + 6 else NA_real_)
  })

  # ---- contrast averaged over subadult swab dates (for the m11g comparison) ----
  # m11g has no season term; the closest seasonal equivalent of its contrast is the contrast
  # averaged over the days subadults were actually swabbed
  sa_day = d$day[d$life_stage_simple == "subadult"]
  w = tabulate(round((sa_day - days[1]) / grid_step_days) + 1, nbins = length(days))
  w = w / sum(w)
  subadult_weighted = tibble(
    .draw = seq_along(draw_ids),
    prevalence = as.vector((lp$prevalence$subadult - lp$prevalence$adult) %*% w),
    load = as.vector((lp$load$subadult - lp$load$adult) %*% w))

  list(convergence = conv_check(fit),
       sds = sds_summary(fit),
       stage_curves = stage_curves,
       contrast_curves = contrast_curves,
       summary_draws = summary_draws,
       window_info = window_info,
       subadult_weighted = subadult_weighted) %>%
    map(~ mutate(.x, taxon_capture = spp, .before = 1))
}

if (refresh || !file.exists(results_file)) {
  processed = imap(model_files, function(f, spp) {
    message("processing ", spp)
    fit = readRDS(f)
    out = process_season_fit(fit, spp)
    rm(fit); gc()
    out
  })
  saveRDS(processed, results_file)
} else {
  processed = readRDS(results_file)
}

# stack each component across species
bind_part = function(part) map_dfr(processed, part)
convergence = bind_part("convergence")
sds_all = bind_part("sds")
stage_curves = bind_part("stage_curves")
contrast_curves = bind_part("contrast_curves")
summary_draws = bind_part("summary_draws")
window_info = bind_part("window_info")
subadult_weighted = bind_part("subadult_weighted")

```

# Fit health
```{r}
# a compact flag carried with every result, so a problem fit is not read uncritically. the full
# checks (LOO, predictive checks, prior sensitivity) are in 02_season_all_species.qmd.
# thresholds as in conv_check (season_check_functions.R); a few divergences are tolerated.
fit_health = convergence %>%
  mutate(fit_ok = max_rhat < 1.01 & min_ess_bulk > 400 & min_ess_tail > 400 &
           n_divergent <= 5 & min_ebfmi > 0.3)

fit_health %>%
  select(taxon_capture, n_obs, max_rhat, min_ess_bulk, min_ess_tail, n_divergent, min_ebfmi, fit_ok) %>%
  arrange(fit_ok, desc(n_divergent))

```

# Contrast summaries
```{r}
# coverage class for each part: prevalence uses all swabs, load only positive swabs
coverage_long = season_species_all %>%
  select(taxon_capture, coverage_class_prev, coverage_class_load) %>%
  pivot_longer(-taxon_capture, names_to = "metric", values_to = "coverage_class") %>%
  mutate(metric = if_else(metric == "coverage_class_prev", "prevalence", "load"))

# difference-smooth sds vs its prior: how far the difference curve was allowed to bend. a
# posterior median well above the prior median, with a narrower interval, means the data pull
# the curve away from a constant difference; near or below the prior median means shrunk / not
# informed. context only: the assessable flag below rests on coverage.
sds_prior_median = half_t_quantile(0.5, 1)

sds_diff = sds_all %>%
  filter(smooth == "difference") %>%
  transmute(taxon_capture,
            metric = if_else(part == "hu", "prevalence", "load"),
            sds_diff_median = Q50, sds_diff_lower_95 = Q2.5, sds_diff_upper_95 = Q97.5,
            sds_diff_vs_prior = Q50 / sds_prior_median)

# median / intervals / pd / support for each summary quantity (f_draw_agg, as in the unified
# analysis). long -> wide: window_mean_median, early_lower_95, ...
summary_draws_long = summary_draws %>%
  pivot_longer(c(window_mean, early, late, late_minus_early, amplitude),
               names_to = "quantity", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value))

contrast_agg = f_draw_agg(summary_draws_long, c("taxon_capture", "metric", "quantity"), "value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = quantity, values_from = starts_with("value_"),
              names_glue = "{quantity}_{.value}") %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("_value_", "_", .x))

# posterior probabilities used by the typology
contrast_probs = summary_draws %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, metric, window) %>%
  summarise(p_early_gt_0 = mean(early > 0),
            p_late_gt_0 = mean(late > 0),
            p_late_gt_early = mean(late > early),
            # is the gap smaller (in absolute size) late than early?
            p_abs_shrinks = mean(abs(late) < abs(early)),
            .groups = "drop")

# is seasonal change assessable for this part? only with broad co-sampling coverage (from the
# screen) and enough co-sampled days here. otherwise the summary is a constant offset or a
# window mean over a narrow band, and any curve shape is extrapolation or shrinkage.
contrast_summary = window_info %>%
  left_join(coverage_long, by = c("taxon_capture", "metric")) %>%
  left_join(contrast_probs, by = c("taxon_capture", "metric")) %>%
  left_join(contrast_agg, by = c("taxon_capture", "metric")) %>%
  left_join(sds_diff, by = c("taxon_capture", "metric")) %>%
  left_join(fit_health %>% select(taxon_capture, fit_ok), by = "taxon_capture") %>%
  mutate(assessable = coverage_class == "broad" & window == "co-sampled")

# readable version
q_str = function(x) sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", median(x), quantile(x, 0.025), quantile(x, 0.975))

summary_draws %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, metric) %>%
  summarise(window = first(window),
            window_mean = q_str(window_mean),
            late_minus_early = if (all(is.na(late_minus_early))) NA_character_ else q_str(late_minus_early),
            amplitude = if (all(is.na(amplitude))) NA_character_ else q_str(amplitude),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(contrast_summary %>% select(taxon_capture, metric, coverage_class, assessable, fit_ok),
            by = c("taxon_capture", "metric")) %>%
  mutate(taxon_capture = factor(taxon_capture, levels = species_order)) %>%
  arrange(metric, taxon_capture)

```

# Typology (first pass)
```{r}
# rules as in 03_season_analysis.Rmd, applied only where seasonal change is assessable:
#   reversing   credibly one sign early and the other late (p > typology_p for each end)
#   constant    late - early not credible: the season does not detectably alter the gap
#   converging  the gap credibly changes and shrinks in absolute size
#   diverging   the gap credibly changes and grows in absolute size
#   shifting    the gap credibly changes, but whether it shrinks or grows is unclear
# elsewhere: "constant offset (not assessable)". this says the data cannot address seasonal
# change, NOT that the gap is constant.
typology_p = 0.9

typology = contrast_summary %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(
    !assessable ~ "constant offset (not assessable)",
    (p_early_gt_0 > typology_p & p_late_gt_0 < 1 - typology_p) |
      (p_early_gt_0 < 1 - typology_p & p_late_gt_0 > typology_p) ~ "reversing",
    p_late_gt_early > 1 - typology_p & p_late_gt_early < typology_p ~ "constant",
    p_abs_shrinks > typology_p ~ "converging",
    p_abs_shrinks < 1 - typology_p ~ "diverging",
    .default = "shifting")) %>%
  select(taxon_capture, metric, coverage_class, assessable, type, window_mean_median,
         window_mean_support, early_median, late_median, p_late_gt_early, p_abs_shrinks,
         sds_diff_vs_prior, fit_ok)

typology %>% filter(assessable)

# one row per species, phylogenetic order
typology %>%
  select(taxon_capture, metric, type) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = type) %>%
  mutate(taxon_capture = factor(taxon_capture, levels = species_order)) %>%
  arrange(taxon_capture)

```

# Consistency with the unified model (m11g)
```{r}
# seasonal contrast averaged over subadult swab dates vs m11g's contrast at each species' median
# subadult weather. not expected to match exactly (m11g has weather terms and a different
# random-effect / prior structure), but intervals that do not overlap are worth understanding
# before interpreting the seasonal curves.
seasonal_weighted = subadult_weighted %>%
  pivot_longer(c(prevalence, load), names_to = "metric", values_to = "contrast") %>%
  mutate(model = "seasonal (subadult-date weighted)")

# m11g species x stage draws (link scale), exported by 03_size_bd_unified_analysis.qmd
m11g_draws = read_parquet(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates",
                               "unified_03_b_spp_lss_draws.parquet")) %>%
  filter(taxon_capture %in% names(model_files)) %>%
  select(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple, .draw, hu, mu) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = life_stage_simple, values_from = c(hu, mu)) %>%
  transmute(taxon_capture, .draw,
            prevalence = -(hu_subadult - hu_adult),   # logit prevalence = -logit(hu)
            load = mu_subadult - mu_adult) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(prevalence, load), names_to = "metric", values_to = "contrast") %>%
  filter(!is.na(contrast)) %>%                       # species without an estimable m11g mu contrast
  mutate(model = "unified m11g")

consistency_m11g = bind_rows(seasonal_weighted, m11g_draws) %>%
  f_draw_agg(c("taxon_capture", "metric", "model"), "contrast")

# do the 95% intervals overlap?
consistency_m11g %>%
  select(taxon_capture, metric, model, contrast_lower_95, contrast_upper_95) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(contrast_lower_95, contrast_upper_95)) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_replace_all(.x, c(" \\(subadult-date weighted\\)" = "", "unified " = ""))) %>%
  mutate(overlap = contrast_lower_95_seasonal <= contrast_upper_95_m11g &
           contrast_lower_95_m11g <= contrast_upper_95_seasonal) %>%
  filter(!overlap | is.na(overlap))

```

# Consistency with the six-species stage-curve models
```{r}
# for the six data-rich species: the same quantity (window mean over co-sampled days) from the
# stage-curve parameterization (03_season_analysis.Rmd). agreement = the pattern does not depend
# on how the model is parameterized. windows differ slightly (day-of-year vs origin weeks).
six_file = here("size_bd_season", "intermediates", "03_season_contrast_summary.csv")

if (file.exists(six_file)) {
  consistency_six = bind_rows(
    read_csv(six_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      transmute(taxon_capture, metric, model = "stage curves (six species)",
                median = window_mean_median, lower_95 = window_mean_lower_95,
                upper_95 = window_mean_upper_95),
    contrast_summary %>%
      transmute(taxon_capture, metric, model = "difference smooth (all species)",
                median = window_mean_median, lower_95 = window_mean_lower_95,
                upper_95 = window_mean_upper_95)) %>%
    group_by(taxon_capture, metric) %>%
    filter(n() == 2) %>%
    ungroup()
  consistency_six
} else {
  consistency_six = NULL
  message("run 03_season_analysis.Rmd first for the six-species comparison")
}

```

# Visualize
```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 12

stage_colors = c(adult = "#7570B3", subadult = "#D95F02")
coverage_colors = c(broad = "#1B9E77", narrow = "#E6AB02", none = "grey60")

# days since origin -> calendar date in a dummy year starting at the species' origin. dates run
# past the year end where the season crosses the new year, so the axis stays continuous.
add_date = function(df) {
  df %>%
    left_join(season_species_all %>% select(taxon_capture, origin_doy), by = "taxon_capture") %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date("2001-01-01") + (origin_doy - 1) + day,
           species = factor(species_label(taxon_capture), levels = species_levels))
}

assessable_species = function(metric_name) {
  contrast_summary %>% filter(metric == metric_name, assessable) %>% pull(taxon_capture)
}

# ---- window-mean contrast, all species ----
# the main per-species comparison: average stage gap over the co-sampled window (or the constant
# offset where nothing is co-sampled), colored by coverage. hollow points: fit flagged.
p_window = contrast_summary %>%
  mutate(species = factor(species_label(taxon_capture), levels = rev(species_levels)),
         metric = factor(metric, levels = c("prevalence", "load"),
                         labels = c("logit prevalence contrast", "log load contrast")),
         fit_flag = if_else(fit_ok, "ok", "check fit")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = window_mean_median, y = species, color = coverage_class)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = window_mean_lower_95, xmax = window_mean_upper_95), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = window_mean_lower_50, xmax = window_mean_upper_50), linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = fit_flag), size = 2, fill = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = coverage_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(ok = 16, `check fit` = 21)) +
  labs(x = "subadult - adult (median, 50% / 95% interval)", y = NULL,
       color = "coverage", shape = NULL,
       subtitle = "mean over co-sampled weeks (constant offset where none); phylogenetic order") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"), legend.position = "bottom")

# ---- contrast curves, assessable species ----
plot_contrast_curves = function(metric_name, y_lab, color) {
  contrast_curves %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name, taxon_capture %in% assessable_species(metric_name)) %>%
    add_date() %>%
    mutate(across(c(median, lower_50, upper_50, lower_95, upper_95),
                  ~ if_else(co_sampled, .x, NA_real_))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95), fill = color, alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_50, ymax = upper_50), fill = color, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(y = median), linewidth = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ species, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_lab,
         subtitle = "broad-coverage species; co-sampled weeks only; > 0 = subadults higher") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "italic"))
}

# ---- stage curves, assessable species ----
# solid where the stage was sampled, faint where the curve is extrapolated
plot_stage_curves = function(metric_name, y_lab) {
  stage_curves %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name, taxon_capture %in% assessable_species(metric_name)) %>%
    add_date() %>%
    mutate(across(c(median, lower_50, upper_50, lower_95, upper_95),
                  ~ if_else(sampled, .x, NA_real_), .names = "{.col}_s")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = date, group = life_stage_simple)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = median, color = life_stage_simple), alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_95_s, ymax = upper_95_s, fill = life_stage_simple), alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_50_s, ymax = upper_50_s, fill = life_stage_simple), alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_line(aes(y = median_s, color = life_stage_simple), linewidth = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ species, scales = "free") +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b") +
    scale_color_manual(values = stage_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = stage_colors) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_lab, color = "stage", fill = "stage",
         subtitle = "broad-coverage species; typical population and year; faint = outside sampled weeks") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "italic"))
}

p_contrast_prev = plot_contrast_curves("prevalence", "subadult - adult (logit prevalence)", "#8DA0CB")
p_contrast_load = plot_contrast_curves("load", "subadult - adult (log load)", "#FC8D62")
p_stage_prev = plot_stage_curves("prevalence", "Bd prevalence")
p_stage_load = plot_stage_curves("load", "log Bd load (positives)")

# ---- consistency plots ----
plot_consistency = function(df, colors) {
  df %>%
    mutate(species = factor(species_label(taxon_capture), levels = rev(species_levels)),
           metric = factor(metric, levels = c("prevalence", "load"),
                           labels = c("logit prevalence contrast", "log load contrast"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = median, y = species, color = model)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
    geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lower_95, xmax = upper_95), linewidth = 0.5,
                   position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    labs(x = "subadult - adult (median, 95% interval)", y = NULL, color = NULL) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"), legend.position = "bottom")
}

p_consistency_m11g = consistency_m11g %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("^contrast_", "", .x)) %>%
  plot_consistency(c("#1B9E77", "#7570B3"))

p_consistency_six = if (!is.null(consistency_six)) {
  plot_consistency(consistency_six, c("#1B9E77", "#D95F02"))
}

# ---- save ----
ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "03_all_window_mean_contrast.png"), p_window, width = 10, height = 9)
ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "03_all_contrast_curves_prevalence.png"), p_contrast_prev, width = 12, height = 8)
ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "03_all_contrast_curves_load.png"), p_contrast_load, width = 12, height = 8)
ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "03_all_stage_curves_prevalence.png"), p_stage_prev, width = 12, height = 8)
ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "03_all_stage_curves_load.png"), p_stage_load, width = 12, height = 8)
ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "03_all_consistency_m11g.png"), p_consistency_m11g, width = 10, height = 9)
if (!is.null(p_consistency_six)) {
  ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "03_all_consistency_six_species.png"), p_consistency_six, width = 9, height = 4.5)
}

p_window
p_contrast_prev
p_contrast_load
p_stage_prev
p_stage_load
p_consistency_m11g
p_consistency_six

```

# Export
```{r}
# day = days since the species' seasonal origin; add origin_doy so curves can be put back on the
# calendar downstream
stage_curves_out = stage_curves %>%
  left_join(season_species_all %>% select(taxon_capture, origin_doy), by = "taxon_capture")
contrast_curves_out = contrast_curves %>%
  left_join(season_species_all %>% select(taxon_capture, origin_doy), by = "taxon_capture")
contrast_summary_out = contrast_summary %>%
  left_join(typology %>% select(taxon_capture, metric, type), by = c("taxon_capture", "metric"))

# local intermediates
write_parquet(stage_curves_out, file.path(intermediates_dir, "03_all_stage_curves.parquet"))
write_parquet(contrast_curves_out, file.path(intermediates_dir, "03_all_contrast_curves.parquet"))
write_csv(contrast_summary_out, file.path(intermediates_dir, "03_all_contrast_summary.csv"))
write_csv(typology, file.path(intermediates_dir, "03_all_typology.csv"))
write_csv(fit_health, file.path(intermediates_dir, "03_all_fit_health.csv"))
write_csv(consistency_m11g, file.path(intermediates_dir, "03_all_consistency_m11g.csv"))

# manuscript essential data. stage curves are absolute levels (comparable within a species only:
# labs differ); center within species when plotting in build_intermediates.Rmd
repo_dir = gsub("size_bd_load_analysis", "", here())
manuscript_data_dir = paste0(repo_dir, "size-bd-dynamics-manuscript/resources/01_essential_data/")

write_parquet(stage_curves_out, paste0(manuscript_data_dir, "season_all_03_a_stage_curves.parquet"))
write_csv(contrast_summary_out, paste0(manuscript_data_dir, "season_all_03_b_contrast_summary.csv"))
write_parquet(contrast_curves_out, paste0(manuscript_data_dir, "season_all_03_c_contrast_curves.parquet"))
```
